Starting Tuesday 12 November, you can export any report as a CSV file. The new export option is available on all plans.

To use it, head to Reports → Export, select the report you'd like to download, and choose CSV. The export includes all columns currently shown in that report, so you'll get a faithful snapshot of what you're looking at on screen.

This should make it easy to pull your data into spreadsheets, CRMs, or any other tool for further analysis or sharing.

No setup or configuration is needed — the feature is live for everyone from Tuesday. Happy exporting!
